The Subtask Name: Investigation of Specific Genome Browser Page

  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: irrecoverability_issue
      description: The Orchestrator might prematurely declare the task complete based on insufficient data (e.g., assuming the Ensembl page is the answer without verifying the specific May 2020 relevance).
